_notice: FICTITIOUS. Patient outreach campaigns for a support program and product that do not exist.
usage: Each campaign is a schedule of approved texts (approved-messages.json) keyed to a reference date, with the conditions a patient must meet on each step's day. The rules in campaign-rules.json apply to every step. A step is evaluated at the start of its day in the patient's local time, using only fills shipped and keywords received before that moment; if the patient qualifies, the text is sent that day inside quiet hours, unless an opt-out keyword arrives first. A fill shipped on a step's day does not stop that step. Membership and every send can be recomputed from the patient record, the fills and the inbound keywords.

eligibility.all_texts: Adult on the step's day (ENG-09) and a language with approved versions (ENG-07).
eligibility.campaign_texts: CNS-TEXT-OPTIN in force (ENG-01), program status enrolled.

campaigns.enters_if: Enrolled with CNS-CONTACT, adult, supported language.

An opt-out keyword; exits on that day

campaigns.name: Never-start support
campaigns.enters_if: On day 14: CNS-TEXT-OPTIN in force, no fill shipped, prescription not canceled.

tracks.enters_if: On day 7 after the due date: no later fill shipped, treatment not discontinued, CNS-TEXT-OPTIN in force.

program_texts.rule: MSG-REM-REFILL 3 days before the due date, if on that day: CNS-TEXT-OPTIN and CNS-TEXT-REMINDERS in force, no later fill shipped, treatment not discontinued.
